# Unsullied Blade (Rosa trait)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Unsullied Blade
- **Mechanic tags:** hero-trait, conversion, true-damage

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Spell→attack bridge, Mercury Baptism true-damage stage, per-weapon main-hand split, unsealed_mana into the trait loop.

## Implementation (engine model)

Modeled in `unsullied_blade.py::apply`. Base node disabled (`slot_levels[0] < 1`) → trait off. Base always emits `spell_dmg_to_attack = 1.0` (offense bridges Spell bonuses onto attacks), `max_mercury_points_flat = 100`, and `spell_dmg_additional` (`_SPELL_DMG_ADD` [0..0.20] by base level). Two mutually-exclusive states from conditions: `mystic_mercury` (build-up, consumes mana) overrides `realm_of_mercury` (default ON, the DPS state). In Realm: `attack_speed_additional` + `elemental_dmg_additional` = 0.02 per 10% `unsealed_mana`/`max_mana` (both stashed by compute after reservation), capped +20% (`_REALM_MAX_INCREMENTS`). Mana cycle emits `mana_consumed_pct_current_per_attack_use_mystic` 0.10 (Mystic) or `mana_restored_pct_current_per_attack_use` 0.15 (Realm, −30% with Born to Cleanse). Baptism of Purity (L45) emits `max_mana_additional` +0.20 and, in Realm, `mercury_baptism_fraction` (`_BAPTISM_FRACTION` [0.12..0.44], a true-damage stage in offense) plus sets `enemy_affected_by_<dominant>_infiltration` (dominant element from `stash`). L60/L75 picks (Cleanse Filth, Boundless Sanctuary, Utmost Devotion, Born to Cleanse) emit capped `elemental_dmg_additional` scaling on Max Mana / weighted enemy count / Mercury Points. Unless Utmost Devotion is picked, emits `mana_consume_external_blocked = 1` (only Mystic may consume mana). NYI/limitations: Mercury-point economy (30/s drain) not simulated; Artificial Moon AS-per-Baptism not modeled; "1% if insufficient" mana fallback omitted.
